releaseNotes: Text blocks now use a rich-text editing overlay while keeping the existing Notes data model and BOOX-safe base renderer underneath
Text colors are now cursor/selection based: type in black, switch to red and continue typing in red without recoloring the previous text
Bold, italic and underline also work on the current selection or from the current cursor position
Automatic text block growth expands to the right first and then downward as required
Width and height are persisted continuously and restored from saved note geometry after Text/Pen/Marker/Eraser mode switches
Manual resize uses the dedicated BOOX-safe handle and saves dimensions while dragging
Textblock deletion keeps the LuMa confirmation dialog
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
